description: This file implements functions related to the BN_CTX structure used in OpenSSL for managing big number contexts. It includes creation, initialization, freeing, starting a context, acquiring objects, and ending a context, primarily for memory management purposes in cryptographic operations.

methods.name: BN_CTX * BN_CTX_new(void)
methods.description: Creates a new BN_CTX object, allocates memory, and initializes it.

methods.name: void BN_CTX_init(BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Initializes an existing BN_CTX object by setting default values and initializing internal BIGNUMs.

methods.name: void BN_CTX_free(BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Frees a BN_CTX object, including its internal BIGNUMs, and deallocates memory if it was allocated dynamically.

methods.name: void BN_CTX_start(BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Marks a point in the BN_CTX to manage temporary BIGNUMs, increasing the context's depth.

methods.name: BIGNUM * BN_CTX_get(BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Provides a pointer to a BIGNUM from the context, managing the top-of-stack for temporary variables.

methods.name: void BN_CTX_end(BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Marks the end of a block of temporary BIGNUMs, reducing the context's depth and restoring previous state.
